authoredFamilies.label: GPU stream fan-out, cache outage and slow acknowledgement
authoredFamilies.derivation: GPU batch releases four chunks before the first 100 ms consumer acknowledgement. Baseline has one active plus one waiting slot, rejecting two; the remaining second chunk sees a cache outage. Repair admits all four and bypasses the crashed cache to its real origin edge. Repaired cache restarts cold and later fills/hits. Inputs and cache outage are unchanged.

authoredBaseline.name: GPU stream fan-out, cache outage and slow acknowledgement

authoredFamilies.label: Explicit replica link partition and finite retry
authoredFamilies.derivation: Three writes arrive at 0,0.4,0.8s. First replication crosses a partition until0.05s and fails with one attempt, but a100ms second-attempt policy repairs it. The fixed leader crashes0.35–0.6s then recovers for100ms, so the second write fails in both designs and the third succeeds after0.7s. Baseline completes1/fails2; repair completes2/fails1. Both commit2localwrites; follower applies1versus2. No election or consensus.

authoredFamilies.label: Collected-document RAG, structured tool calls and outage recovery
authoredFamilies.derivation: One bounded synthetic crawler fetch produces exactly one capped chunk and one index upsert, published before questions at 0.1/0.3 s. First question reaches a tool during outage until0.15 s and fails without retries; second succeeds. A single100ms retry repairs first question. Typed embed/search/generate and structured validation all execute; provider output is configured valid, while malformed-output repair is independently tested elsewhere.
